name: Weatherly 620 Ag Plane
summary: California-built single-seat ag plane, a larger development of the Weatherly 201. All-metal cantilever low wing with a big hopper and a radial engine.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
Long, unswept wing with noticeable dihedral
engines: Single Pratt & Whitney R-985 radial in a round cowl
fuselage: Large hopper in front of a single-seat cockpit set high and aft

tellTales: Single-seat crop duster with a radial nose and a strut-free low wing
Large hopper ahead of a high, aft cockpit

confusedWith.howToTell: The 201 is the smaller, earlier version with a smaller hopper and a shorter span; the 620 has a longer wing (about 47 ft) and a bigger hopper.
The Thrush is usually larger, with a bigger radial or a turbine up front and a stouter fuselage; the Weatherly is a smaller R-985 airframe.
The Air Tractor is bigger and heavier with a taller cockpit and a bigger nose; the Weatherly is a smaller R-985 airplane.
The Dromader is larger, with a ~1,000 hp radial and a bigger cowl; the Weatherly has a smaller R-985.
